steps.name: environment - prepare venv, validate workspace, persist env
steps.description: Create or reuse a workspace-local Python venv at WS/.venv, ensure pip is available in the venv, validate workspace is writable (fail fast on read-only mounts), perform a venv-python-based compatibility check when STREAMLIT_VERSION is provided, export STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS for the current process, and atomically create a deterministic /etc/profile.d/streamlit_headless.sh that embeds absolute paths. If /etc/profile.d is not writable, create a workspace fallback file WS/.env_streamlit with absolute paths and instruct automation to source it.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WS"
# verify workspace writable
if ! touch "$WS/.workspace_write_test" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: workspace not writable ($WS) - check mount/ownership" >&2; exit 2; else rm -f "$WS/.workspace_write_test"; fi
# create venv if missing
[ -d "$WS/.venv" ] || python3 -m venv "$WS/.venv"
VENV="$WS/.venv"
PYBIN="$VENV/bin/python"
if [ ! -x "$PYBIN" ]; then echo "ERROR: venv python missing at $PYBIN" >&2; exit 3; fi
# ensure pip
"$PYBIN" -m ensurepip --upgrade >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
"$PYBIN" -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo "ERROR: pip not available in venv" >&2; exit 4)
# Pre-flight: if STREAMLIT_VERSION provided, verify venv python meets >=3.x requirement implied by version
if [ -n "${STREAMLIT_VERSION-}" ]; then
  # determine venv python version tuple
  read -r PY_MAJOR PY_MINOR PY_PATCH <<<$("$PYBIN" - <<'PY'
import sys
v=sys.version_info
print(v[0], v[1], v[2])
PY
)
  # example minimal mapping: streamlit >=1.25 requires py>=3.8 (adjust if required)
  MIN_MAJOR=3; MIN_MINOR=8
  if [ "$PY_MAJOR" -lt "$MIN_MAJOR" ] || ( [ "$PY_MAJOR" -eq "$MIN_MAJOR" ] && [ "$PY_MINOR" -lt "$MIN_MINOR" ] ); then
    echo "ERROR: venv python $PY_MAJOR.$PY_MINOR.$PY_PATCH is too old for STREAMLIT_VERSION=$STREAMLIT_VERSION (require >=${MIN_MAJOR}.${MIN_MINOR})" >&2; exit 5
  fi
fi
export STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS=true
# Persist deterministic env: write to temp then sudo move to /etc/profile.d if possible, embedding absolute paths
PROFILE="/etc/profile.d/streamlit_headless.sh"
TMPFILE=$(mktemp --tmpdir streamlit_env.XXXXXX)
cat > "$TMPFILE" <<EOF
# Auto-generated: Streamlit headless + workspace venv
export STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS=true
export PATH="$WS/.venv/bin:":"$PATH"
EOF
if sudo test -d /etc/profile.d && sudo test -w /etc/profile.d >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo mv "$TMPFILE" "$PROFILE" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
  echo "" >/dev/null
else
  rm -f "$TMPFILE"
  # Workspace-level fallback with absolute paths
  cat > "$WS/.env_streamlit" <<EOF
# Source this file in automation if /etc/profile.d is not writable
export STREAMLIT_SERVER_HEADLESS=true
export PATH="$WS/.venv/bin:":"$PATH"
EOF
fi
exit 0

steps.name: scaffolding - detect entrypoint and ensure pinned requirements
steps.description: Detect common Streamlit entry filenames (app.py, main.py, streamlit_app.py). If none exist and workspace is writable (not a read-only mount), create a minimal placeholder app.py. Ensure requirements.txt contains a pinned streamlit==X.Y.Z; if missing and STREAMLIT_VERSION provided, create requirements.txt with the pinned streamlit and a comment for optional libs. If requirements.txt exists but lacks a pinned streamlit, the script will attempt an opt-in auto-pin when STREAMLIT_AUTO_PIN=yes is set, otherwise fail with guidance.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WS"
# look for common entry filenames only
candidates=("app.py" "main.py" "streamlit_app.py")
found=""
for f in "${candidates[@]}"; do [ -f "$WS/$f" ] && found="$f" && break || true; done
# create placeholder only if none found and workspace writable
if [ -z "$found" ]; then
  if touch "$WS/.scaffold_write_test" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -f "$WS/.scaffold_write_test"
    cat > "$WS/app.py" <<'PY'
import streamlit as st
st.title('Placeholder App')
st.write('Replace with project app .py files mounted into the container')
PY
    found="app.py"
  else
    echo "WARN: no entrypoint found and workspace not writable; skipping placeholder creation" >&2
  fi
fi
REQ="$WS/requirements.txt"
if [ -f "$REQ" ]; then
  if ! grep -E '^[[:space:]]*streamlit==[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?' "$REQ" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "${STREAMLIT_AUTO_PIN-}" = "yes" ] && [ -n "${STREAMLIT_VERSION-}" ]; then
      # append pinned streamlit
      printf "\nstreamlit==%s\n" "$STREAMLIT_VERSION" >> "$REQ"
    else
      echo "ERROR: $REQ exists but does not contain pinned streamlit==X.Y.Z. Set STREAMLIT_AUTO_PIN=yes and STREAMLIT_VERSION to auto-insert or update $REQ manually." >&2
      exit 6
    fi
  fi
else
  if [ -z "${STREAMLIT_VERSION-}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: no requirements.txt and STREAMLIT_VERSION not provided. Set STREAMLIT_VERSION to create requirements.txt." >&2
    exit 7
  fi
  printf "streamlit==%s\n# add pandas, reportlab or fpdf if required by the app\n" "$STREAMLIT_VERSION" > "$REQ"
fi
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies - install python deps into venv and verify streamlit version
steps.description: Install Python packages from workspace requirements.txt into the workspace venv using a robust invocation of the venv python ("$PYBIN" -m pip) with non-interactive pip flags (--no-cache-dir, --disable-pip-version-check). Capture concise logs and verify that the installed streamlit version matches STREAMLIT_VERSION when provided. Avoid global installs and do not use eval or space-split variables.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WS"
VENV="$WS/.venv"
PYBIN="$VENV/bin/python"
UPGRADE_LOG="$WS/pip_upgrade.log"
INSTALL_LOG="$WS/pip_install.log"
if [ ! -x "$PYBIN" ]; then echo "ERROR: venv python missing at $PYBIN" >&2; exit 2; fi
# upgrade pip setuptools wheel using direct python -m pip
"$PYBIN" -m pip install --upgrade --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check pip setuptools wheel > "$UPGRADE_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$UPGRADE_LOG" >&2; exit 6)
# install requirements non-interactively
if [ -f "$WS/requirements.txt" ]; then
  "$PYBIN" -m pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check -r "$WS/requirements.txt" > "$INSTALL_LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$INSTALL_LOG" >&2; exit 7)
else
  echo "ERROR: requirements.txt missing at $WS" >&2; exit 8
fi
# verify installed streamlit matches STREAMLIT_VERSION when provided
if [ -n "${STREAMLIT_VERSION-}" ]; then
  INSTVER=$("$PYBIN" -m pip show streamlit 2>/dev/null | awk -F': ' '/^Version:/{print $2}') || true
  if [ -z "${INSTVER}" ]; then echo "ERROR: streamlit not installed after pip install" >&2; exit 9; fi
  if [ "${INSTVER}" != "${STREAMLIT_VERSION}" ]; then echo "ERROR: installed streamlit==$INSTVER does not match expected STREAMLIT_VERSION=${STREAMLIT_VERSION}" >&2; exit 10; fi
fi
# print concise installed versions for diagnostics
"$PYBIN" - <<'PY' > "$WS/installed_versions.txt"
import importlib
for pkg in ('streamlit','pandas','reportlab','fpdf'):
    try:
        m=importlib.import_module(pkg)
        v=getattr(m,'__version__',None)
        print(f"{pkg}=={v}" if v else f"{pkg} installed (version unknown)")
    except Exception:
        print(f"{pkg} not installed")
PY
exit 0

steps.name: testing - install pinned pytest and run namespaced import test
steps.description: Install a pinned pytest into the venv and run a single namespaced import test (.ci_test_streamlit_env.py) that fails if streamlit cannot be imported. The test reports optional missing libs but only fails on streamlit absence. This avoids colliding with project tests and keeps behavior deterministic by pinning pytest.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WS"
VENV="$WS/.venv"
PYBIN="$VENV/bin/python"
PYTEST_VER="7.4.0"
TESTFILE="$WS/.ci_test_streamlit_env.py"
LOG="$WS/pytest_install.log"
# install pinned pytest
"$PYBIN" -m pip install --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check pytest=="$PYTEST_VER" > "$LOG" 2>&1 || (tail -n 200 "$LOG" >&2; exit 8)
# create namespaced test file
cat > "$TESTFILE" <<'PY'
import importlib
import pytest
failed = []
for pkg in ('streamlit',):
    try:
        importlib.import_module(pkg)
    except Exception as e:
        pytest.fail(f"{pkg} import failed: {e}")
# optional: check presence of pdf libs but do not fail
for pkg in ('pandas','reportlab','fpdf'):
    try:
        importlib.import_module(pkg)
    except Exception:
        print(f"OPTIONAL_MISSING: {pkg}")
PY
# run pytest on the single file
"$PYBIN" -m pytest -q "$TESTFILE"
exit 0

steps.name: validation - start streamlit headless via venv python, health-check, and stop cleanly
steps.description: Start the Streamlit app headless using the venv python: "$PYBIN" -m streamlit run <app>.py --server.port=8501 --server.address=0.0.0.0. Capture PID, create a new process group for reliable termination, perform health checks (/health then /) with bounded exponential backoff and overall timeout, persist logs into workspace, and stop the server by killing the process group without unnecessary sudo. Accept optional app filename arg (defaults to app.py).
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/finmate-streamlit-18626-18629/StreamlitApplication"
cd "$WS"
VENV="$WS/.venv"
PYBIN="$VENV/bin/python"
PORT=8501
APP=${1:-app.py}
if [ ! -x "$PYBIN" ]; then echo "ERROR: venv python not found at $PYBIN" >&2; exit 9; fi

ST_PID=$!

success_path=""

    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$p" || true)
    case "$code" in 2*|3*) success_path="$p"; break 2;; esac
  done
  sleep $wait_seconds
  total_wait=$((total_wait+wait_seconds))
  attempts=$((attempts+1))
  wait_seconds=$((wait_seconds*2)); [ $wait_seconds -gt 10 ] && wait_seconds=10
done
if [ -z "$success_path" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Streamlit did not become healthy (tried /health and /). waited ${total_wait}s" >> "$WORK_LOG"
  tail -n 400 "$TMPLOG" >> "$WORK_LOG" || true
  # attempt clean shutdown
  if [ -n "$PGID" ] && [ "$PGID" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  kill "$ST_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  cp "$TMPLOG" "$WORK_LOG" || true
  echo "logfile=$WORK_LOG"
  exit 10
fi
# success evidence
echo "Streamlit healthy at path=$success_path" >> "$WORK_LOG"
head -n 80 "$TMPLOG" >> "$WORK_LOG" || true
cp "$TMPLOG" "$WORK_LOG" || true
rm -f "$TMPLOG" || true
echo "streamlit_pid=$ST_PID"; echo "streamlit_pgid=$PGID"; echo "logfile=$WORK_LOG"
# stop server by PGID preferred
if [ -n "$PGID" ] && [ "$PGID" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  kill "$ST_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# wait up to 12s for shutdown
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  if ! ps -p "$ST_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi

done
if ps -p "$ST_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -n "$PGID" ] && [ "$PGID" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

reasoning: Keep a minimal, idempotent 5-step in-container setup that: (1) prepares a workspace-local venv and deterministic persistent env file in /etc/profile.d when writable (expanding absolute paths), (2) ensures a safe scaffold that only creates a placeholder when no common Streamlit entrypoint exists and does not overwrite mounts, (3) installs dependencies into the venv using the venv Python invocation (no eval or space-split variables), with pip flags for non-interactive installs and verification the installed streamlit matches the pinned version if provided, (4) runs a namespaced pytest import check using a dedicated CI test file and a pinned pytest install, and (5) validates start/stop by invoking streamlit via the venv python (-m streamlit) to avoid shims, performing bounded backoff health checks and reliably terminating the process group without unnecessary sudo. I addressed CRITICAL and HIGH findings: Python version check now queries the venv python and compares tuple versions robustly (no bc), persistent files contain expanded absolute workspace paths and are atomically moved into /etc/profile.d using sudo when needed, pip is invoked via "$PYBIN" -m pip to avoid eval/word-splitting, placeholder scaffold avoids overwriting mounts and only looks for common entry filenames, pytest is pinned during install and the test filename is namespaced, and validation uses "$PYBIN" -m streamlit so the monitored PID is the expected Python process. Also added a workspace permission check to fail fast if the workspace is read-only or not writable by the current user. Scripts follow shebang, set -euo pipefail, use the authoritative workspace path, and minimize sudo usage to only privileged operations. This balances robustness with concise automation suitable for non-interactive execution.
